state:
Goal `core-time-instant-and-1-more` covers every `Core\Time\Instant` and `Core\Time\TimeOfDay` member. The
`dossier-core-time-instant` check is green: `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Time\Instant'` says nothing
owed, 27 examples and 9 attacks ok. Every `Instant` member has about.md, three examples, an attack, a bench, a
`covers:`-marked Rust `#[test]` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`'s tests and a `.nvst` case, and its card is
in the plain voice. The `since` proof found one bug, now fixed: `nanos_between` multiplied the whole seconds
out before adding the part of a second, so a distance of exactly `i64::MAX` or `i64::MIN` nanoseconds threw.
It computes in `i128` now, pinned by `tests/conformance/core/time-instant-since-reaches-the-longest-duration-both-ways.nvst`.
Every `Core\Time` class's benches were re-measured after the last `time.rs` edit. What is left is the
`dossier-core-time-timeofday` check. Nothing is blocked.
